blocks.text: The University of the Philippines Association of Civil Engineering Students (UP ACES) brought together thousands of students, educators, and industry professionals for the 22nd National Civil Engineering Summit (NCES). Held across multiple venues in UP Diliman over five days, the gathering centered on the theme “Axes Redefined: Aligning Systems towards Principled Engineering,” challenging participants to align technical excellence with ethical accountability. The summit opened on September 18 at the UP Institute of Civil Engineering (UP ICE) Main Building with Jumpstart, carrying the tagline “Embark with Vision.” The event marked months of preparation with a ribbon-cutting, summit blessing, and the traditional “Grand […]...
